class Comment(Item):
    """
    A comment literal.
    """

    @property
    def discriminant(self) -> int:
        return 1

    def as_string(self) -> str:
        return f"{self._trivia.indent}{self._comment_str()}{self._trivia.trail}"

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self._trivia.indent}{self._comment_str()}"

    def _comment_str(self) -> str:
        """
        The comment part of this item, without indent/trail.

        A multi-line comment is rendered as one ``#``-prefixed line per
        input line (a lone ``#`` for empty lines) so the result stays
        valid TOML.
        """
        comment = self._trivia.comment
        if "\n" not in comment:
            return decode(comment)

        rendered = []
        for line in comment.split("\n"):
            if not line.strip():
                line = "#"
            elif not line.startswith("#"):
                line = "#" + line
            elif line.startswith("# ") and len(line) > 1:
                line = "#" + line[2:]
            rendered.append(decode(line))
        return "\n".join(rendered)
